EmailTemplate.subject: Thanks for joining our Virtual Roadshow!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for attending our Q4 UK & IE Higher Education Virtual Roadshow. We hope you enjoyed learning more about global payment trends, preferences, and regulations and why flexibility, choice, and digitisation are crucial in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic.
Here are links to the webinar recording and slideshow presentation: Slides: https://www.flywire.com/resources/virtual-event-recording-q4-uk-ie-virtual-roadshow-rethinking-the-education-payment-process-in-a-post-covid-19-world Recording: https://more.flywire.com/rs/372-QSQ-649/images/Flywire_Q4_UK_IE_Virtual_Roadshow_Slides_11_19_20.pdf
Would you like to learn more? We have a few options:
Join our next webinar with BUFDG & discover how University of Arts London streamlines their payment process > 25/11 @ 10am. Register here: https://www.bufdg.ac.uk/eventbooking/view?id=4096.
Request a demo & see our solution in action, including how you can make refunds easy, integrate seamlessly with Tribal & more: https://www.flywire.com/demo?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=q4-uk-roadshow
Thank you!
